articles.summary: Adaptive-reuse project will transform former newspaper headquarters into new, market-rate housing and retail space Eastern Bank is pleased to announce it has led the financing for High Tide Capital LLC’s historic redevelopment of The Day Building in downtown New London, Connecticut. Eastern is providing $16.9 million in construction-related financing to support the conversion of the former newspaper headquarters into 68 market-rate apartments and approximately 2,100 square feet of ground-floor retail space. The Day Complex comprises four historic buildings at the center of New London, immediately adjacent to the Amtrak Station, regional ferry terminal servicing Long Island and surrounding areas, and the new Coast Guard Museum. The Day Building served as the home base for The Day newspaper for 140 years, where thousands of newspapers were printed daily and distributed across Eastern Connecticut.
